एकं पात्रमथासाद्य देयास्तु बहवः स्मृताः ॥
गवां प्रदाने यत्नेन परीक्ष्यो ब्राह्मणो भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.62.m: Having found a single worthy recipient, many may be given, so it is handed down. / In the granting of cows, a brahmin must be examined with diligence.

3.62.s:
yathākathañcid dattvā gāṃ dhenuṃ vā'dhenumeva vā ..
arogāmaparikliṣṭāṃ dātā svarge mahīyate ..9..
3.62.d:
यथाकथञ्चिद् दत्त्वा गां धेनुं वाऽधेनुमेव वा ॥
अरोगामपरिक्लिष्टां दाता स्वर्गे महीयते ॥9॥
3.62.m: Having given a cow in any manner whatsoever, whether a milch cow or a non-milch cow, / free from disease and not distressed, the giver is honored in heaven.

3.62.s:
dattvā vatsatarīṃ viprāḥ svargaloke mahīyate ..
gurviṇīṃ ca tathā dattvā vasūnāṃ lokamaśnute .. 3.306.10 ..
3.62.d:
दत्त्वा वत्सतरीं विप्राः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
गुर्विणीं च तथा दत्त्वा वसूनां लोकमश्नुते ॥ 3.306.10 ॥
3.62.m: Having given a heifer, O brahmins, he is honored in the world of heaven. / And having given a pregnant one likewise, he enjoys the world of the Vasus.

3.62.s:
prasūyamānāṃ tāṃ dattvā bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet ..
sravaṃtyāṃ ca tathā dattvā nandane modate naraḥ ..11..
3.62.d:
प्रसूयमानां तां दत्त्वा भूमिदानफलं लभेत् ॥
स्रवंत्यां च तथा दत्त्वा नन्दने मोदते नरः ॥11॥
3.62.m: Having given her while she is giving birth, he obtains the fruit of the gift of land. / And having given [her] while her milk flows, a man rejoices in the Nandana [grove].

3.62.s:
śvetāṃ dattvā somaloke raktāṃ dattvā vibhāvasoḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃ dattvā tathā yāmye nīlāṃ dattvā ca vāruṇe .. 12 ..
3.62.d:
श्वेतां दत्त्वा सोमलोके रक्तां दत्त्वा विभावसोः ॥
कृष्णां दत्त्वा तथा याम्ये नीलां दत्त्वा च वारुणे ॥ 12 ॥
3.62.m: By giving a white [cow, one is honoured] in the world of Soma; by giving a red one, in that of Agni; / by giving a black one, in Yama's realm; and by giving a blue-black one, in Varuṇa's.

3.62.s:
indraloke tu śabalāmindraloke tu rohiṇīm ..
vātareṇusavarṇāṃ tu vāyuloke mahīyate .. 13 ..
3.62.d:
इन्द्रलोके तु शबलामिन्द्रलोके तु रोहिणीम् ॥
वातरेणुसवर्णां तु वायुलोके महीयते ॥ 13 ॥
3.62.m: A dappled one [leads] to the world of Indra, and a tawny one to the world of Indra; / while [by giving one] the colour of wind-blown dust, one is magnified in the world of Vāyu.

3.62.s:
dhūmravarṇāṃ tathā dattvā vasūnāṃ lokamaśnute ..
āṣāḍhena savarṇāntu lokaṃ vāruṇamāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
3.62.d:
धूम्रवर्णां तथा दत्त्वा वसूनां लोकमश्नुते ॥
आषाढेन सवर्णान्तु लोकं वारुणमाप्नुयात् ॥ 14 ॥
3.62.m: By giving a smoke-coloured one, he attains the world of the Vasus; / and [by giving one] matching the colour of the Āṣāḍha [cloud], he attains the world of Varuṇa.

3.62.s:
suvarṇavarṇāṃ kauberaṃ tāmrāmāṅgirasaṃ tathā ..
palāladhūmravarṇābhāṃ pitṛlokaṃ tathaiva ca..15..
3.62.d:
सुवर्णवर्णां कौबेरं ताम्रामाङ्गिरसं तथा ॥
पलालधूम्रवर्णाभां पितृलोकं तथैव च॥15॥
3.62.m: A gold-coloured one [brings] the realm of Kubera, a copper-coloured one that of the Āṅgirasas, / and one resembling the colour of straw-smoke [brings] the world of the ancestors.

3.62.s:
śitikaṇṭhāpradānena vaiśvadevamavāpnuyāt ..
gaurīṃ dattvā bhṛgūṇāñca vairāṭābhāṃ prajāpateḥ .. 16 ..
3.62.d:
शितिकण्ठाप्रदानेन वैश्वदेवमवाप्नुयात् ॥
गौरीं दत्त्वा भृगूणाञ्च वैराटाभां प्रजापतेः ॥ 16 ॥
3.62.m: By bestowing a dark-necked one, one attains the realm of the Viśvedevas; / by giving a yellowish-white one, that of the Bhṛgus; and one resembling a cat's eye, that of Prajāpati.

3.62.s:
pāṇḍukambalavarṇābhāṃ rudrāṇāṃ lokamāpnuyāt ..
śuklabinducitāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ gandharvaiḥ saha modate .. 17 ..
3.62.d:
पाण्डुकम्बलवर्णाभां रुद्राणां लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥
शुक्लबिन्दुचितां कृष्णां गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते ॥ 17 ॥
3.62.m: One resembling the colour of a white woolen blanket brings the world of the Rudras; / [giving] a black one covered with white spots, he rejoices with the gandharvas.

3.62.s:
(kapilāñca tathā dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ lokamāpnuyāt ..)
gāvaḥ prakṛtivarṇāstu kapilāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 18 ..
3.62.d:
(कपिलाञ्च तथा दत्त्वा यथेष्टं लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥)
गावः प्रकृतिवर्णास्तु कपिलाः परिकीर्तिताः ॥ 18 ॥
3.62.m: (And by giving a kapilā cow, he attains whatever world he desires.) / Cows of their original, natural colour are declared to be kapilā.

3.62.s:
kṛtantu varṇavaicitryaṃ pūrvaṃ tāsāntu śambhunā ..
yathā tu gaṅgā saritāṃ dhenūnāṃ kapilā tathā .. 19 ..
3.62.d:
कृतन्तु वर्णवैचित्र्यं पूर्वं तासान्तु शम्भुना ॥
यथा तु गङ्गा सरितां धेनूनां कपिला तथा ॥ 19 ॥
3.62.m: Their diversity of colours was produced of old by Śambhu. / Just as the Gaṅgā is among rivers, so is the kapilā among milch cows.

3.62.s:
sāyaṃ prātaśca satataṃ homakāle dvijottamāḥ ..
gāvo dadati vai haumyamṛṣibhyo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 3.306.20 ..
3.62.d:
सायं प्रातश्च सततं होमकाले द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
गावो ददति वै हौम्यमृषिभ्यो नात्र संशयः ॥ 3.306.20 ॥
3.62.m: Constantly at evening and at morning, at the time of the fire offering, O foremost of the twice-born, / cows indeed provide the sacrificial offering to the sages; of this there is no doubt.

3.62.s:
duṣkṛtāni duriṣṭāni durgāṇi viṣamāṇi ca ..
taranti caiva pāpebhyo dhenudānena mānavāḥ .. 21 ..
3.62.d:
दुष्कृतानि दुरिष्टानि दुर्गाणि विषमाणि च ॥
तरन्ति चैव पापेभ्यो धेनुदानेन मानवाः ॥ 21 ॥
3.62.m: Through the gift of a milch cow, men cross over / misdeeds, ill-performed rites, perilous places, and rough paths, and from their sins.

3.62.s:
ekāṃ gāṃ daśagurdadyāddaśa dadyācca gośatī ..
śataṃ sahasragurdadyātsarve tulyaphalā hi te .. 22 ..
3.62.d:
एकां गां दशगुर्दद्याद्दश दद्याच्च गोशती ॥
शतं सहस्रगुर्दद्यात्सर्वे तुल्यफला हि ते ॥ 22 ॥
3.62.m: One who owns ten cows should give one; one who owns a hundred cows should give ten; / one who owns a thousand cows should give a hundred; for they all reap equal fruit.

3.62.s:
śatavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ suduścaram ..
gobhiḥ pūrvavisṛṣṭābhirgacchema śreṣṭhatāmiti .. 23 ..
3.62.d:
शतवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्तं सुदुश्चरम् ॥
गोभिः पूर्वविसृष्टाभिर्गच्छेम श्रेष्ठतामिति ॥ 23 ॥
3.62.m: Austerity very hard to practice was performed for a hundred thousand years / by the cows created of old, [praying:] 'May we attain pre-eminence!

3.62.s:
loke'smindakṣiṇānāñca sarvā gā vayasottarāḥ ..
bhave tāni ca liṃpyema doṣeṇātiparantapāḥ .. 24 ..
3.62.d:
लोकेऽस्मिन्दक्षिणानाञ्च सर्वा गा वयसोत्तराः ॥
भवे तानि च लिंप्येम दोषेणातिपरन्तपाः ॥ 24 ॥
3.62.m: In this world of sacrificial fees, may all cows be superior by age; / and may we not be stained by any fault in existence, O tormentors of foes!

3.62.s:
śakṛttāsāṃ pavitrārthaṃ kurvīrandevamānuṣāḥ ..
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca .. .. 25 ..
3.62.d:
शकृत्तासां पवित्रार्थं कुर्वीरन्देवमानुषाः ॥
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥ ॥ 25 ॥
3.62.m: May gods and men use their dung for the sake of purification, / and likewise all beings, both stationary and moving!

3.62.s:
pradātāraśca golokāngaccheyuriti mānadāḥ ..
etaddhanaṃ dadau tāsāṃ sarvameva pitāmahaḥ .. 26 ..
3.62.d:
प्रदातारश्च गोलोकान्गच्छेयुरिति मानदाः ॥
एतद्धनं ददौ तासां सर्वमेव पितामहः ॥ 26 ॥
3.62.m: And may those who bestow [us] go to the world of cows, O givers of honour!' / The Grandfather gave all this wealth to them.

3.62.s:
surabhirdevadhenuryā tasyāḥ putratvamāgatāḥ ..
dharmo vṛṣabharūpeṇa mahādevadhvajaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 27 ..
3.62.d:
सुरभिर्देवधेनुर्या तस्याः पुत्रत्वमागताः ॥
धर्मो वृषभरूपेण महादेवध्वजः स्मृतः ॥ 27 ॥
3.62.m: They attained the status of sons of Surabhi, who is the divine cow. / Dharma in the form of a bull is traditionally known as the banner of Mahādeva.

3.62.s:
daśadhenupradānena yatheṣṭāṅgatimāpnuyāt ..
śatañca dattvā dharmajñaḥ śakralokamupāgataḥ .. 28 ..
3.62.d:
दशधेनुप्रदानेन यथेष्टाङ्गतिमाप्नुयात् ॥
शतञ्च दत्त्वा धर्मज्ञः शक्रलोकमुपागतः ॥ 28 ॥
3.62.m: By the gift of ten milch cows, one attains whatever destination he desires; / and having given a hundred, one who knows dharma arrives at the world of Śakra.

3.62.s:
kalpāvaśeṣaṃ sa sukhī modatyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ..
dattvā sahasraṃ dhenūnāṃ sarvapāpairvimucyate .. 29 ..
3.62.d:
कल्पावशेषं स सुखी मोदत्यप्सरसां गणैः ॥
दत्त्वा सहस्रं धेनूनां सर्वपापैर्विमुच्यते ॥ 29 ॥
3.62.m: For the remainder of the aeon, he rejoices happily with hosts of apsarases; / by giving a thousand milch cows, he is freed from all sins.

3.62.s:
ukṣṇāṃ ca ye prayacchanti śatena saha yūthapam ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste prayāntyamarāvatīm .. 3.306.30 ..
3.62.d:
उक्ष्णां च ये प्रयच्छन्ति शतेन सह यूथपम् ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते प्रयान्त्यमरावतीम् ॥ 3.306.30 ॥
3.62.m: And those who give a hundred oxen along with the leader of the herd, / fully freed from all sins, go to Amarāvatī.

3.62.s:
kalpāvaśeṣaṃ tridive sukhamupya narottamāḥ ..
mānuṣye dhanasaṃyuktā bhavanti sukhinastataḥ .. 31 ..
3.62.d:
कल्पावशेषं त्रिदिवे सुखमुप्य नरोत्तमाः ॥
मानुष्ये धनसंयुक्ता भवन्ति सुखिनस्ततः ॥ 31 ॥
3.62.m: Having dwelt happily in heaven for the remainder of the aeon, O best of men, / they then become happy on attaining human birth, endowed with wealth.

3.62.s:
sahasreṇa gavāṃ sārdhaṃ ye prayacchanti yūthapam ..
alaṃkṛtaṃ yathāśaktyā golokaṃ yānti te narāḥ .. 32 ..
3.62.d:
सहस्रेण गवां सार्धं ये प्रयच्छन्ति यूथपम् ॥
अलंकृतं यथाशक्त्या गोलोकं यान्ति ते नराः ॥ 32 ॥
3.62.m: Those men who give a thousand cows together with the leader of the herd, / adorned according to their ability, go to the world of cows.

3.62.s:
ukṣāṇamindriyopetaṃ yastu dadyāddvijātaye ..
daśadhenuphalaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 33 ..
3.62.d:
उक्षाणमिन्द्रियोपेतं यस्तु दद्याद्द्विजातये ॥
दशधेनुफलं तस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 33 ॥
3.62.m: He who gives an ox endowed with virility to a twice-born, / obtains the fruit of ten milch cows; no doubt should be entertained on this point.

3.62.s:
goyugaṃ ye prayacchanti sīrayūpayutaṃ dvijāḥ ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya prāpnuvanti phalaṃ narāḥ .. 34 ..
3.62.d:
गोयुगं ये प्रयच्छन्ति सीरयूपयुतं द्विजाः ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य प्राप्नुवन्ति फलं नराः ॥ 34 ॥
3.62.m: Those men who give a pair of cattle equipped with a plough and yoke, O twice-born, / obtain the reward of one who is enriched with all desired objects.

3.62.s:
gobhiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ rathaṃ dattvā dvijātaye ..
dhānyairvastrairyutaṃ śaktyā śakralokaṃ vrajanti te .. 35 ..
3.62.d:
गोभिश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तं रथं दत्त्वा द्विजातये ॥
धान्यैर्वस्त्रैर्युतं शक्त्या शक्रलोकं व्रजन्ति ते ॥ 35 ॥
3.62.m: Having given to a twice-born a chariot yoked with four cows, / furnished with grain and garments according to their capacity, they go to the world of Śakra.

3.62.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya tathā bhavanti vasudhādhipāḥ ..
śakaṭasya pradānantu vinā gobhirmahāphalam .. .. 36 ..
3.62.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य तथा भवन्ति वसुधाधिपाः ॥
शकटस्य प्रदानन्तु विना गोभिर्महाफलम् ॥ ॥ 36 ॥
3.62.m: And on attaining human birth, they become rulers of the earth. / The gift of a cart, even without cattle, brings great reward;

3.62.s:
viśeṣeṇa mahābhāgāstasya gobhiryutasya ca ..
sasasyaṃ śakaṭaṃ dattvā nākalokaṃ mahīyate .. 37 ..
3.62.d:
विशेषेण महाभागास्तस्य गोभिर्युतस्य च ॥
ससस्यं शकटं दत्त्वा नाकलोकं महीयते ॥ 37 ॥
3.62.m: especially so, O fortunate ones, when it is equipped with cattle. / Having given a cart laden with grain, one is magnified in heaven.

3.62.s:
dattvā tu dhenuṃ homārthe brāhmaṇāyāhitāgnaye ..
godānaphalamāpnoti homadānaphalaṃ tathā .. 38 ..
3.62.d:
दत्त्वा तु धेनुं होमार्थे ब्राह्मणायाहिताग्नये ॥
गोदानफलमाप्नोति होमदानफलं तथा ॥ 38 ॥
3.62.m: By giving a milch cow for the purpose of the fire offering to a brahmin who maintains the sacred fires, / he obtains the fruit of the gift of a cow and also the fruit of the gift of a fire offering.

3.62.s:
snapanārthaṃ tathā dattvā dhenuṃ rudrasurālaye ..
rudralokamavāpnoti kulañcaiva samuddharet .. .. 39 ..
3.62.d:
स्नपनार्थं तथा दत्त्वा धेनुं रुद्रसुरालये ॥
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति कुलञ्चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
3.62.m: Likewise, by giving a milch cow for the bath [of the deity] in a temple of Rudra, / he attains the world of Rudra and uplifts his family.

3.62.s:
dattvā sacailaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mahādevālaye naraḥ ..
rudralokamavāpnoti kulamuddharate tathā .. 3.306.40 ..
3.62.d:
दत्त्वा सचैलं वृषभं महादेवालये नरः ॥
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरते तथा ॥ 3.306.40 ॥
3.62.m: Having given a bull with a cloth in a temple of Mahādeva, a man / attains the world of Rudra and likewise uplifts his family.

3.62.s:
dhenūnāṃ kapilā śreṣṭhā vṛṣabhaḥ śveta ucyate ..
śvetantu vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā phalasyānantyamaśnute .. 43 ..
3.62.d:
धेनूनां कपिला श्रेष्ठा वृषभः श्वेत उच्यते ॥
श्वेतन्तु वृषभं दत्त्वा फलस्यानन्त्यमश्नुते ॥ 43 ॥
3.62.m: Among milch cows, the kapilā is the best; a white bull is said [to be foremost]. / By giving a white bull, one enjoys endless reward.

3.62.s:
dadhikṣīrahitārthāya vāsudevasurālaye ..
dattvā gāṃ madhuparkārthaṃ cānantaṃ phalamāpnuyāt .. 42 ...
3.62.d:
दधिक्षीरहितार्थाय वासुदेवसुरालये ॥
दत्त्वा गां मधुपर्कार्थं चानन्तं फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 42 ॥।
3.62.m: In a temple of Vāsudeva, for the sake of curd and milk / and for the honey-mixture, having given a cow, he attains endless reward.

3.62.s:
gopradānaratā yānti golokaṃ mānavottamāḥ ..
sahāpsarobhirmuditā vimānavaramāsthitāḥ .. 43 ..
3.62.d:
गोप्रदानरता यान्ति गोलोकं मानवोत्तमाः ॥
सहाप्सरोभिर्मुदिता विमानवरमास्थिताः ॥ 43 ॥
3.62.m: Those excellent men who take delight in the gift of cows go to the world of cows, / rejoicing together with apsarases, mounted on a supreme celestial chariot.

3.62.s:
apāmadhastālloko yo tasyopari mahīdharāḥ ..
nāgānāmupariṣṭādbhūḥ pṛthivyupari mānavāḥ .. 44 ..
3.62.d:
अपामधस्ताल्लोको यो तस्योपरि महीधराः ॥
नागानामुपरिष्टाद्भूः पृथिव्युपरि मानवाः ॥ 44 ॥
3.62.m: The world that is beneath the waters, above that are the mountains; / above the nāgas is the earth; above the earth are human beings.

3.62.s:
manuṣyalokādūrdhvantu khagānāṃ gatirucyate ..
ākāśasyopari ravirdvāraṃ svargasya tatsmṛtam .. .. 45..
3.62.d:
मनुष्यलोकादूर्ध्वन्तु खगानां गतिरुच्यते ॥
आकाशस्योपरि रविर्द्वारं स्वर्गस्य तत्स्मृतम् ॥ ॥ 45॥
3.62.m: Above the world of men is said to be the course of birds; / above the sky is the sun; that is remembered as the gate of heaven.

3.62.s:
devalokaḥ parastasmādbrahmalokastataḥ param..
tatropari gavāṃ loko viṣṇulokastataḥ param ..46..
3.62.d:
देवलोकः परस्तस्माद्ब्रह्मलोकस्ततः परम्॥
तत्रोपरि गवां लोको विष्णुलोकस्ततः परम् ॥46॥
3.62.m: Beyond that is the world of the gods; beyond that is the world of Brahmā; / above that is the world of cows; beyond that is the world of Viṣṇu.

3.62.s:
ekastvadho duṣkṛtināṃ karmiṇāṃ pṛthivī matā..
brāhme tapasi yuktānāṃ brahmalokaḥ sanātanaḥ ..47 ..
3.62.d:
एकस्त्वधो दुष्कृतिनां कर्मिणां पृथिवी मता॥
ब्राह्मे तपसि युक्तानां ब्रह्मलोकः सनातनः ॥47 ॥
3.62.m: The earth is regarded as the one [destination] below for evildoers and men of ritual action; / the eternal world of Brahmā is for those engaged in the austerities of Brahmā.

3.62.s:
gavāmeva hi goloko durārohā hi sā gatiḥ ..
ekāntino viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇulokaṃ vrajanti te . 48 ..
3.62.d:
गवामेव हि गोलोको दुरारोहा हि सा गतिः ॥
एकान्तिनो विष्णुभक्ता विष्णुलोकं व्रजन्ति ते । 48 ॥
3.62.m: The world of cows belongs indeed to cows; that destination is difficult to ascend. / Those single-minded devotees of Viṣṇu go to the world of Viṣṇu.

3.62.s:
gopradānaratā yāṃti golokaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
tatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ .. 49 ..
3.62.d:
गोप्रदानरता यांति गोलोकं सर्वकामदम् ॥
तत्र कामफला वृक्षा नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः ॥ 49 ॥
3.62.m: Those devoted to the gift of cows go to the world of cows which grants all desires. / There, trees bear desired fruits, and rivers have mud of rice boiled in milk.

3.62.s:
suvarṇasikatāścānyā vimalāmbuyutāḥ śubhāḥ ..
yathākāmepsitāstatra bhavanti śubhakarmiṇām .. 3.306.50 ..
3.62.d:
सुवर्णसिकताश्चान्या विमलाम्बुयुताः शुभाः ॥
यथाकामेप्सितास्तत्र भवन्ति शुभकर्मिणाम् ॥ 3.306.50 ॥
3.62.m: And there are other auspicious [rivers] with golden sands, endowed with pure water; / there, they are available as desired to those who performed auspicious deeds.

3.62.s:
deśā manoharāḥ śubhrā devārāmavibhūṣaṇāḥ ..
divyena nṛtyagītena vāditreṇa manoharāḥ .. 51 ..
3.62.d:
देशा मनोहराः शुभ्रा देवारामविभूषणाः ॥
दिव्येन नृत्यगीतेन वादित्रेण मनोहराः ॥ 51 ॥
3.62.m: The regions are charming, bright, adorned with divine groves, / captivating with celestial dance, song, and musical instruments.

3.62.s:
tatrepsitānāṃ kāmānāmāptirbhavati nityadā ..
hemaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurāṃ muktālāṃgūlabhūṣaṇām .. 52 ..
3.62.d:
तत्रेप्सितानां कामानामाप्तिर्भवति नित्यदा ॥
हेमशृङ्गीं रूप्यखुरां मुक्तालांगूलभूषणाम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.62.m: There, the attainment of desired wishes occurs at all times. / [Bestowing a cow] with golden horns, silver hooves, decorated with pearls on her tail,

3.62.s:
ahatāmbarasaṃvītāṃ tathā kāṃsyopadohinīm ..
trirātraṃ sthaṃḍile suptvā trirātraṃ gorasāśanaḥ .. 53 ..
3.62.d:
अहताम्बरसंवीतां तथा कांस्योपदोहिनीम् ॥
त्रिरात्रं स्थंडिले सुप्त्वा त्रिरात्रं गोरसाशनः ॥ 53 ॥
3.62.m: clothed in unworn garments, and with a bronze milking vessel, / having slept for three nights on the bare ground and eating the products of the cow for three nights,

3.62.s:
tṛptāntu tarpite dattvā vāsasā saṃvṛtāṃ dvijāḥ ..
sadakṣiṇāṃ mahābhāgāstrirātraṃ gorasaistataḥ .. 54 ..
3.62.d:
तृप्तान्तु तर्पिते दत्त्वा वाससा संवृतां द्विजाः ॥
सदक्षिणां महाभागास्त्रिरात्रं गोरसैस्ततः ॥ 54 ॥
3.62.m: having given [her] satisfied to one who is gratified, covered with a garment, O twice-born, / along with a sacrificial fee, O fortunate ones, and thereafter for three nights

3.62.s:
prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā gavāṃ loke mahīyate ..
yāvanti dhenuromāṇi tāvadvarṣāṇi mānavaḥ .. 55 ..
3.62.d:
प्राणसंधारणं कृत्वा गवां लोके महीयते ॥
यावन्ति धेनुरोमाणि तावद्वर्षाणि मानवः ॥ 55 ॥
3.62.m: sustaining his vital breaths with the products of the cow, a man is honoured / in the world of cows for as many years as there are hairs on the milch cow.

3.62.s:
dattaivaṃ kapilāṃ viprāḥ prāpnotyabhyadhikaṃ phalam ..
sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam .. 56 ..
3.62.d:
दत्तैवं कपिलां विप्राः प्राप्नोत्यभ्यधिकं फलम् ॥
सायं प्रातर्मनुष्याणामशनं देवनिर्मितम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.62.m: Having thus given a kapilā cow, O brahmins, he obtains an even greater fruit. / Evening and morning meal is established by the gods for men.

3.62.s:
tatraikakālamaśnanto dvitīyādaśanānnaraḥ ..
yathoktavidhinā dadyātkrītvā tu kapilāṃ naraḥ .. 57 ..
3.62.d:
तत्रैककालमश्नन्तो द्वितीयादशनान्नरः ॥
यथोक्तविधिना दद्यात्क्रीत्वा तु कपिलां नरः ॥ 57 ॥
3.62.m:
Eating only once [a day] from the second meal, a man,
having purchased a brown cow, should give [her] according to the prescribed rite;

3.62.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
gavāṃ lokamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam .. 58 ..
3.62.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
गवां लोकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.62.m:
he obtains the fruit of a sacrifice replete with all desires,
attains the world of cows, and redeems his own lineage.

3.62.s:
alaṃkṛtāṃ tato dattvā godānaphalamāpnuyāt ..
ajāmalaṃkṛtāṃ dattvā vahniloke mahīyate .. 59 ..
3.62.d:
अलंकृतां ततो दत्त्वा गोदानफलमाप्नुयात् ॥
अजामलंकृतां दत्त्वा वह्निलोके महीयते ॥ 59 ॥
3.62.m:
Then, having given her adorned, he would obtain the fruit of gifting a cow.
Having given a decorated she-goat, he is glorified in the world of Agni.

3.62.s:
tadeva lokamāpnoti dattvājaṃ vidhivannaraḥ ..
vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnoti dattvā ca mahiṣīṃ naraḥ..3.306.60..
3.62.d:
तदेव लोकमाप्नोति दत्त्वाजं विधिवन्नरः ॥
वारुणं लोकमाप्नोति दत्त्वा च महिषीं नरः॥3.306.60॥
3.62.m:
A man attains that very world by giving a he-goat according to rule;
and by giving a female buffalo, a man attains the world of Varuṇa.

3.62.s:
mahiṣasya pradānena yāmye loke mahīyate ..
vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnoti dattvorabhraṃ narottamaḥ .. 61.
3.62.d:
महिषस्य प्रदानेन याम्ये लोके महीयते ॥
वारुणं लोकमाप्नोति दत्त्वोरभ्रं नरोत्तमः ॥ 61.
3.62.m:
Through the gift of a male buffalo, he is glorified in the world of Yama.
Having given a ram, the best among men attains the world of Varuṇa.

3.62.s:
avipradātā śatadhā tadeva phalamaśnute ..
āraṇyapaśudānena vāyuloke mahīyate .. 62 ..
3.62.d:
अविप्रदाता शतधा तदेव फलमश्नुते ॥
आरण्यपशुदानेन वायुलोके महीयते ॥ 62 ॥
3.62.m:
The giver of a ewe enjoys that very fruit a hundredfold.
Through the gift of a wild animal, he is glorified in the world of Vāyu.

3.62.s:
etadeva phalaṃ proktaṃ pradānena ca pakṣiṇām ..
śastrapiṇḍaki jālādirudakādānatastathā .. 63 ..
3.62.d:
एतदेव फलं प्रोक्तं प्रदानेन च पक्षिणाम् ॥
शस्त्रपिण्डकि जालादिरुदकादानतस्तथा ॥ 63 ॥
3.62.m:
This very fruit is proclaimed through the gift of birds,
and likewise through the gift of water, weapons, balls [of food], and nets.

3.62.s:
gorasānāṃ pradānena tṛptimāpnotyanuttamām ..
tatra vāśvayuje māse yastu dadyāddvijātiṣu .. 64 ..
3.62.d:
गोरसानां प्रदानेन तृप्तिमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
तत्र वाश्वयुजे मासे यस्तु दद्याद्द्विजातिषु ॥ 64 ॥
3.62.m:
Through the gift of cow-products, he attains unsurpassed satisfaction;
and whoever should give to the twice-born in the month of Āśvayuja,

3.62.s:
ārogyaṃ mahadāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate ..
tathā dadhnaḥ pradānena maṅgalānyāpnute sadā .. 65 ..
3.62.d:
आरोग्यं महदाप्नोति यत्रयत्राभिजायते ॥
तथा दध्नः प्रदानेन मङ्गलान्याप्नुते सदा ॥ 65 ॥
3.62.m:
attains great health wherever he is born.
Likewise, through the gift of curd, he always obtains auspicious things.

3.62.s:
kṣīradastṛptimāpnoti sarvaduḥkhairvimucyate ..
kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kṛtvā harasya prayato naraḥ .. 66 ..
3.62.d:
क्षीरदस्तृप्तिमाप्नोति सर्वदुःखैर्विमुच्यते ॥
क्षीरेण स्नपनं कृत्वा हरस्य प्रयतो नरः ॥ 66 ॥
3.62.m:
The giver of milk attains satisfaction and is freed from all sorrows.
A restrained man, having performed the bathing of Hara with milk,

3.62.s:
mano'bhitāpanirmukto rudraloke mahīyate ..
paramānnapradānena kāmānāpnoti śāśvatān.. 67 ..
3.62.d:
मनोऽभितापनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥
परमान्नप्रदानेन कामानाप्नोति शाश्वतान्॥ 67 ॥
3.62.m:
freed from anguish of mind, is glorified in the world of Rudra.
Through the gift of supreme food [rice-milk], he attains eternal desires.

3.62.s:
māsi māsi tu revatyāṃ brāhmaṇānghṛtapāyasam ..
sadakṣiṇaṃ bhojayitvā rūpamāpnotyanuttamam .. 68 ..
3.62.d:
मासि मासि तु रेवत्यां ब्राह्मणान्घृतपायसम् ॥
सदक्षिणं भोजयित्वा रूपमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ 68 ॥
3.62.m:
Month by month on the Revatī [nakṣatra], having fed brahmins
rice-milk cooked with ghee along with a sacrificial fee, he attains unsurpassed beauty.

3.62.s:
ājyantejaḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ cājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param .
ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāraścājye lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 69 ..
3.62.d:
आज्यन्तेजः समुद्दिष्टं चाज्यं पापहरं परम् ।
आज्यं सुराणामाहारश्चाज्ये लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥ 69 ॥
3.62.m:
Ghee is declared to be splendor, and ghee is the supreme destroyer of sin.
Ghee is the food of the gods, and the worlds are established in ghee.

3.62.s:
ājyena liṅgasnapanaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā tu śūlinaḥ ..
sarvaduḥkhavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate .. 3.306.70 ..
3.62.d:
आज्येन लिङ्गस्नपनं नरः कृत्वा तु शूलिनः ॥
सर्वदुःखविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥ 3.306.70 ॥
3.62.m:
A man having bathed the liṅga of the trident-bearer with ghee,
freed from all sorrow, is glorified in the world of Rudra.

3.62.s:
alakṣmīśamanaṃ proktaṃ ghṛtasnānaṃ tathā dvijāḥ ..
kalyamutthāya yo gavyaghṛte mukhamathātmanaḥ . 71 ..
3.62.d:
अलक्ष्मीशमनं प्रोक्तं घृतस्नानं तथा द्विजाः ॥
कल्यमुत्थाय यो गव्यघृते मुखमथात्मनः । 71 ॥
3.62.m:
Bathing with ghee is declared to appease misfortune, O twice-born.
Having risen early in the morning, whoever [looks at] his own face in cow's ghee,

3.62.s:
paśyate sa jahātyeva kṛtvā pāpamaharniśam ..
alakṣmīrnaśyate cāsya kṣiprameṣā karīṣiṇī .. 72 ..
3.62.d:
पश्यते स जहात्येव कृत्वा पापमहर्निशम् ॥
अलक्ष्मीर्नश्यते चास्य क्षिप्रमेषा करीषिणी ॥ 72 ॥
3.62.m:
and sees it, he surely casts away the sin committed day and night;
and his misfortune, rich in cow dung [foulness], is quickly destroyed.

3.62.s:
ghṛtadānānnaro yāti svargalokamasaṃśayam ..
māse cāśvayuje nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ yastu prayacchati .. 73 ..
3.62.d:
घृतदानान्नरो याति स्वर्गलोकमसंशयम् ॥
मासे चाश्वयुजे नित्यं घृतं यस्तु प्रयच्छति ॥ 73 ॥
3.62.m:
From the gift of ghee, a man goes to the heavenly world without doubt.
And whoever always offers ghee in the month of Āśvayuja,

3.62.s:
kalyamutthāya viprebhyaḥ prīṇayecca tathāśvinau ..
sa rūpaṃ mahadāpnoti tathā rogaiśca mucyate ..
evaṃ mahāphalaṃ dānaṃ gorasānāṃ tathā gavām .. 74 ..
3.62.d:
कल्यमुत्थाय विप्रेभ्यः प्रीणयेच्च तथाश्विनौ ॥
स रूपं महदाप्नोति तथा रोगैश्च मुच्यते ॥
एवं महाफलं दानं गोरसानां तथा गवाम् ॥ 74 ॥

3.62.s:
prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ sacailāṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakāgraśṛṅgīm ..
taistairguṇaiḥ kāmadughā ca bhūtvā naraṃ pradātāramupaiti sā gauḥ .. 75 ..
3.62.d:
प्रयच्छते यः कपिलां सचैलां कांस्योपदोहां कनकाग्रशृङ्गीम् ॥
तैस्तैर्गुणैः कामदुघा च भूत्वा नरं प्रदातारमुपैति सा गौः ॥ 75 ॥
3.62.m:
Whoever gives a brown cow along with cloth, with a bronze milking pail and horns tipped with gold—
becoming a wish-yielding cow by those very qualities, she comes to that man, the giver.

3.62.s:
yāvanti romāṇi bhavanti dhenvāstāvatphalaṃ prāpnute gopradātā ..
putrāṃśca pautrāṃśca kulañca sarvamāsaptamaṃ tārayate paratra..76..
3.307
haṃsa uvāca ..
ghṛtadhenupradānañca nibodhata dvijottamāḥ ..
gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhaṃ pūrṇantu parikalpayet ..1..
kalaśañca tathā pūrṇantasyā vatsaṃ prakalpayet ..
kāṃsyāpidhānasacchannasitavastrayutantathā .. 2 ..
hiraṇyagarbhau kartavyāvanuliptau ca bāhyataḥ ..
ikṣuyaṣṭimayānpādānkhurānrūpyamayām̐stathā .. 3 ..
sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kārye śṛṅge cāgurukāṣṭhaje ..
saptadhānyaśca kartavye tasya pārśve pṛthakkṛte .. 4 ..
tasya paṭṭaṃ ca kartavyaṃ kambalaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ ..
kuryātturuṣkaraṃ dūre prāṇe hemamayāṃstanān .. 5 ..
tadvaccharkarayā jihvāṃ guḍakṣīramayaṃ mukham ...
kṣaumasūtreṇa lāṃgūlaṃ romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ .. 6 ..
3.62.d:
यावन्ति रोमाणि भवन्ति धेन्वास्तावत्फलं प्राप्नुते गोप्रदाता ॥
पुत्रांश्च पौत्रांश्च कुलञ्च सर्वमासप्तमं तारयते परत्र॥76॥
3.307
हंस उवाच ॥
घृतधेनुप्रदानञ्च निबोधत द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
गव्यस्य सर्पिषः कुम्भं पूर्णन्तु परिकल्पयेत् ॥1॥
कलशञ्च तथा पूर्णन्तस्या वत्सं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
कांस्यापिधानसच्छन्नसितवस्त्रयुतन्तथा ॥ 2 ॥
हिरण्यगर्भौ कर्तव्यावनुलिप्तौ च बाह्यतः ॥
इक्षुयष्टिमयान्पादान्खुरान्रूप्यमयाम्̐स्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
सौवर्णे चाक्षिणी कार्ये शृङ्गे चागुरुकाष्ठजे ॥
सप्तधान्यश्च कर्तव्ये तस्य पार्श्वे पृथक्कृते ॥ 4 ॥
तस्य पट्टं च कर्तव्यं कम्बलं च द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
कुर्यात्तुरुष्करं दूरे प्राणे हेममयांस्तनान् ॥ 5 ॥
तद्वच्छर्करया जिह्वां गुडक्षीरमयं मुखम् ॥।
क्षौमसूत्रेण लांगूलं रोमाणि सितसर्षपैः ॥ 6 ॥

3.62.s:
tāmrapatramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
etadviracanaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanaiḥ .. 7 ..
harirghṛtārciṣetyevaṃ nāmnā sampūjayedvibhum ..
tatastu gandhapuṣpānnadhūpavastrādibhirnaraḥ .. 8 ..
ghṛtena dīpaṃ dadyācca tathaiva ca ghṛtaṃ diśaḥ ..
homaṃ viprā yadā dhenuṃ dadyādviprāya śaktitaḥ .. 9 ..
ghṛtācī prīyate vipraṃ kalpayitvā ghṛtārciṣam ..
ekarātrañca tāṃ dattvā ghṛtāhārī bhavennaraḥ .. .. 3.307.10 ..
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo lokamāpnoti śāśvatam ..
anena vidhinā snātvā sopavāso naraḥ śuciḥ .. 11 ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
vimānenārkavarṇena gavāṃ loke mahīyate .. 12..
ghṛtakṣīravahā sadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ ..
yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā yatra siddhistu mānasī .. 13 ..
3.62.d:
ताम्रपत्रमयं पृष्ठं कुर्याच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
एतद्विरचनं कृत्वा घृतक्षीराभिषेचनैः ॥ 7 ॥
हरिर्घृतार्चिषेत्येवं नाम्ना सम्पूजयेद्विभुम् ॥
ततस्तु गन्धपुष्पान्नधूपवस्त्रादिभिर्नरः ॥ 8 ॥
घृतेन दीपं दद्याच्च तथैव च घृतं दिशः ॥
होमं विप्रा यदा धेनुं दद्याद्विप्राय शक्तितः ॥ 9 ॥
घृताची प्रीयते विप्रं कल्पयित्वा घृतार्चिषम् ॥
एकरात्रञ्च तां दत्त्वा घृताहारी भवेन्नरः ॥ ॥ 3.307.10 ॥
विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो लोकमाप्नोति शाश्वतम् ॥
अनेन विधिना स्नात्वा सोपवासो नरः शुचिः ॥ 11 ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन गवां लोके महीयते ॥ 12॥
घृतक्षीरवहा सद्यो यत्र पायसकर्दमाः ॥
यत्र कामफला वृक्षा यत्र सिद्धिस्तु मानसी ॥ 13 ॥
3.62.m:
one endowed with faith should make the back of copper plate.
Having made this arrangement, with consecrations of ghee and milk,
one should worship the all-pervading lord with the name 'Hari having ghee for his radiance.'
Then a man, with perfumes, flowers, food, incense, cloth, and the like,
should offer a lamp with ghee, and likewise [offer] ghee to the directions.
When [making] the oblation, O brahmins, one should give the cow to a brahmin according to one's ability.
Ghṛtācī is pleased with the brahmin, having imagined him as radiant with ghee.
Having given her, for one night a man should be an eater of ghee;
freed from all sins, he attains an eternal world.
A pure man, fasting and having bathed according to this rule,
enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice replete with all desires;
and in a celestial chariot the color of the sun, he is glorified in the world of cows,
where streams flow with ghee and milk, where the mud is rice-pudding,
where trees yield desired fruits, and where accomplishment comes by mere thought,

3.62.s:
gandharvāpsarasāṃ yatra satataṃ gītanartanam ..
tatrāste suciraṃ loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .. 14 ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogaḥ śīlena rūpeṇa dhanena yuktaḥ ..
manobhirāmaḥ pramadāpriyaśca dhanānvitaḥ sarvasukhopapannaḥ .. 15 ..
3.308
.. haṃsa uvāca ..
tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpabhayāpahām ..
dhenvākārāntu tāṃ kuryādāvike kambale budhaḥ .. 1 ..
tilaṣoḍaśabhiḥ prasthaiścaturbhirvatsameva tu ..
tilaprasāraṇaṃ kuryāddhenvā dhenupramāṇataḥ .. 2 ..
tatastu racayeddhenuṃ ratnairvakṣyāmyahaṃ dvijāḥ ..
hemaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurāṃ gandhaghrāṇavatīṃ śubhām .. 3 ..

ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ kuryānmuktāphalekṣaṇām .. 4 ..

sragdāmapuṣpāṃ kurvīta navanītastanānvitām .. 5 ..
3.62.d:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसां यत्र सततं गीतनर्तनम् ॥
तत्रास्ते सुचिरं लोके यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ॥ 14 ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगः शीलेन रूपेण धनेन युक्तः ॥
मनोभिरामः प्रमदाप्रियश्च धनान्वितः सर्वसुखोपपन्नः ॥ 15 ॥
3.308
॥ हंस उवाच ॥
तिलधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापभयापहाम् ॥
धेन्वाकारान्तु तां कुर्यादाविके कम्बले बुधः ॥ 1 ॥
तिलषोडशभिः प्रस्थैश्चतुर्भिर्वत्समेव तु ॥
तिलप्रसारणं कुर्याद्धेन्वा धेनुप्रमाणतः ॥ 2 ॥
ततस्तु रचयेद्धेनुं रत्नैर्वक्ष्याम्यहं द्विजाः ॥
हेमशृङ्गीं रूप्यखुरां गन्धघ्राणवतीं शुभाम् ॥ 3 ॥
मिष्टान्नजिह्वां कुर्वीत गुडास्यां सूत्रकम्बलाम् ॥
इक्षुपादां ताम्रपृष्ठां कुर्यान्मुक्ताफलेक्षणाम् ॥ 4 ॥
प्रशस्तपत्रश्रवणां फलदन्तवतीं शुभाम् ॥
स्रग्दामपुष्पां कुर्वीत नवनीतस्तनान्विताम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.62.m:
where there is the perpetual singing and dancing of Gandharvas and Apsarases;
he dwells in that world for a very long time, as long as the fourteen Indras.
Attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, endowed with good character, beauty, and wealth,
delightful to the mind, dear to women, possessed of riches, and endowed with all comforts.
Haṃsa said:
I shall proclaim the sesame-cow, which removes the fear of all sins.
The wise man should make it in the shape of a cow upon a woollen blanket,
with sixteen prasthas of sesame seeds, and the calf indeed with four;
he should make the spreading of sesame according to the measurement of the cow.
Then one should fashion the cow with jewels, O twice-born, which I shall explain:
having golden horns, silver hooves, an auspicious nose of fragrance,
one should make her tongue of sweet food, her mouth of molasses, her blanket of thread,
her legs of sugarcane, her back of copper, and eyes of pearls;
her ears of excellent leaves, having auspicious teeth of fruit;
one should make her with garlands and flowers, and endowed with an udder of fresh butter.

3.62.s:
phalaimarnoharairbhakṣyairmaṇimuktāphalānvitām ..
śubhravastrayugacchannāṃ cārucchatrasamanvitām .. 6 ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ kṛtvā vāsudevantu pūjayet ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā .. 7 ..
juhuyācca tilāneva nāmnā tasyaiva mānavaḥ ..
tameva prīṇayeddadyāddhenuntāmāhitāgnaye .. 8 ..
trirātraṃ yastilāhārastiladhenuṃ prayacchati ..
dattvaikarātrañca punastilānatti dvijottamāḥ .. 9 ..
cāndrāyaṇādabhyadhikaṃ śastantattilabhakṣaṇam ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitaraṃ sapitāmaham .. 3.308.10 ..
tasyāpi pitaraṃ caiva tārayed duṣkṛtānnaraḥ ..
ātmānaṃ putrapautrāṃśca prapautramapi tārayet .. 11 ..
suhṛdaṃ vāpyathoddiśya tiladhenuprado naraḥ ..

so'pi pāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .. 13 ..
3.62.d:
फलैमर्नोहरैर्भक्ष्यैर्मणिमुक्ताफलान्विताम् ॥
शुभ्रवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नां चारुच्छत्रसमन्विताम् ॥ 6 ॥
कांस्योपदोहनां कृत्वा वासुदेवन्तु पूजयेत् ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥ 7 ॥
जुहुयाच्च तिलानेव नाम्ना तस्यैव मानवः ॥
तमेव प्रीणयेद्दद्याद्धेनुन्तामाहिताग्नये ॥ 8 ॥
त्रिरात्रं यस्तिलाहारस्तिलधेनुं प्रयच्छति ॥
दत्त्वैकरात्रञ्च पुनस्तिलानत्ति द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 9 ॥
चान्द्रायणादभ्यधिकं शस्तन्तत्तिलभक्षणम् ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पितरं सपितामहम् ॥ 3.308.10 ॥
तस्यापि पितरं चैव तारयेद् दुष्कृतान्नरः ॥
आत्मानं पुत्रपौत्रांश्च प्रपौत्रमपि तारयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
सुहृदं वाप्यथोद्दिश्य तिलधेनुप्रदो नरः ॥
तारयेद् दुष्कृतात्तञ्च यमुद्दिश्य प्रयच्छति ॥ 12 ॥
यश्च गृह्णाति विधिवद्दीयमानाञ्च पश्यति ॥
सोऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 13 ॥
3.62.m:
Equipped with charming fruits and edible sweets, with gems and pearls, / covered with a pair of white garments, and provided with a beautiful umbrella,
having made a bronze milking vessel, one should worship Vāsudeva / with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, reverent bows, incense, lamps, and food.
And a person should offer sesame seeds into the fire in his name alone; / one should satisfy him alone, and present that cow to a keeper of the sacred fire.
He who, having eaten only sesame seeds for three nights, presents the sesame-cow, / and having given it, eats sesame seeds again for one night, O foremost twice-born,
that consumption of sesame seeds is praised as superior even to a cāndrāyaṇa penance. / Freed from all sins, a person delivers his father and grandfather,
and also his [great-]grandfather from evil deeds; / he delivers himself, his sons and grandsons, and even his great-grandson.
Or a person giving a sesame-cow on behalf of a friend / delivers from evil deeds that very one on whose behalf he offers it.
And he who receives it according to rule, or watches it being given, / even he, freed from sin, is honoured in the world of heaven.

3.62.s:
mahāpātakasaṃyukto yukto yaścopapātakaiḥ ..
tiladhenupradānena so'pi pāvanamāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
salokamāsādya naro vasūnāntatrāpi bhuktvā tridaśendrabhogān..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo dhanānvito rūpasukhopapannaḥ ..15 ..
3.309
haṃsa uvāca ..
jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi prītaye jalaśāyinaḥ ..
jalakumbhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ suvarṇarajatānvitam .. 1 ..
kalpayedratnagarbhañca sthāpayettaṃ yavopari ..
sarvadhānyaistathā grāmyaiḥ samantātparivārayet .. 2 ..
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ dūrvāpallava śobhitam ..
kuṣṭhamāṃsīmurośīravālukāmalakairyutam .. 3 ..
priyaṅgupatrasahitaṃ sitayajñopavītinam ..
sacchatropānahañcaiva soṣṇīṣaṃ parikalpayet .. 4 ..
tilapātrairyutaṃ kṛtvā sahiraṇyaiścaturdiśam ..
dadhyodanayutenātha pātreṇa sthagitaṃ mukhe.. 5 ..
3.62.d:
महापातकसंयुक्तो युक्तो यश्चोपपातकैः ॥
तिलधेनुप्रदानेन सोऽपि पावनमाप्नुयात् ॥ 14 ॥
सलोकमासाद्य नरो वसूनान्तत्रापि भुक्त्वा त्रिदशेन्द्रभोगान्॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो धनान्वितो रूपसुखोपपन्नः ॥15 ॥
3.309
हंस उवाच ॥
जलधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रीतये जलशायिनः ॥
जलकुम्भं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सुवर्णरजतान्वितम् ॥ 1 ॥
कल्पयेद्रत्नगर्भञ्च स्थापयेत्तं यवोपरि ॥
सर्वधान्यैस्तथा ग्राम्यैः समन्तात्परिवारयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं दूर्वापल्लव शोभितम् ॥
कुष्ठमांसीमुरोशीरवालुकामलकैर्युतम् ॥ 3 ॥
प्रियङ्गुपत्रसहितं सितयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥
सच्छत्रोपानहञ्चैव सोष्णीषं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
तिलपात्रैर्युतं कृत्वा सहिरण्यैश्चतुर्दिशम् ॥
दध्योदनयुतेनाथ पात्रेण स्थगितं मुखे॥ 5 ॥
3.62.m:
One burdened with major sins, or one burdened with minor sins, / even he attains purification through the gift of a sesame-cow.
Having reached the world of the Vasus, and having enjoyed the pleasures of the king of the gods even there, / when he attains human birth he becomes free from disease, endowed with wealth, and possessed of beauty and happiness.
3.309
Haṃsa said:
I shall explain the water-cow for the gratification of the One Who Lies upon the Waters. / A water-jar, O best of the twice-born, provided with gold and silver,
and containing jewels inside, one should prepare, and place it upon barley; / and one should surround it on all sides with all kinds of cultivated grains.
It should be covered with a pair of white garments and adorned with dūrvā sprouts, / accompanied by costus, jatamansi, murā, vetiver, vālukā, and amalaki;
with leaves of priyaṅgu, wearing a white sacred thread; / and one should furnish it with an umbrella, shoes, and a turban.
Having provided it in the four directions with dishes of sesame seeds accompanied by gold, / it is then covered at the mouth with a vessel filled with curds and boiled rice.

3.62.s:
kalpayedevamevantu vāridhānīṃ tu vatsakam ..
upoṣitaḥ samabhyarcya deveśaṃ jalaśāyinam .. 6 ..
puṣpadhūpopahāraistu yathāvibhavamāśritaḥ ..
ahatāmbaravītāya dadyādviprāya bhaktimān.. 7 ..
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ mama keśavaḥ ..
iti coccārya taṃ dadyātprīṇayecca dvijo'pi tam..8..
ahorātroṣito dadyādyathāvidhi mayeritam ..
apakvānnāśinā stheyamahorātramataḥ param .. 9 ..
anena vidhinā dattvā jaladhenuṃ dvijottamān ..
sarvāhlādamavāpnoti kāmānāpnoti śāśvatān ..3.309.10..
mokṣamāpnoti sarvebhyastapobhyaḥ sa tathā naraḥ ..
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti rūpañca paramaṃ tathā ..11..
puruṣaḥ sa tathā yāti yasya yasya ca darśanam ..
karoti paramāhlādaṃ tasya tasya dvijottamāḥ .. 12 ..
nityābhitṛpto bhavati tathaiva ca nirāmayaḥ ..
sarvabādhāpraśamanaṃ prāpnoti gatakalmaṣaḥ .. .. 13 ..
3.62.d:
कल्पयेदेवमेवन्तु वारिधानीं तु वत्सकम् ॥
उपोषितः समभ्यर्च्य देवेशं जलशायिनम् ॥ 6 ॥
पुष्पधूपोपहारैस्तु यथाविभवमाश्रितः ॥
अहताम्बरवीताय दद्याद्विप्राय भक्तिमान्॥ 7 ॥
जलशायी जगद्योनिः प्रीयतां मम केशवः ॥
इति चोच्चार्य तं दद्यात्प्रीणयेच्च द्विजोऽपि तम्॥8॥
अहोरात्रोषितो दद्याद्यथाविधि मयेरितम् ॥
अपक्वान्नाशिना स्थेयमहोरात्रमतः परम् ॥ 9 ॥
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा जलधेनुं द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
सर्वाह्लादमवाप्नोति कामानाप्नोति शाश्वतान् ॥3.309.10॥
मोक्षमाप्नोति सर्वेभ्यस्तपोभ्यः स तथा नरः ॥
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति रूपञ्च परमं तथा ॥11॥
पुरुषः स तथा याति यस्य यस्य च दर्शनम् ॥
करोति परमाह्लादं तस्य तस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 12 ॥
नित्याभितृप्तो भवति तथैव च निरामयः ॥
सर्वबाधाप्रशमनं प्राप्नोति गतकल्मषः ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
3.62.m:
In this very same manner one should prepare a water-pitcher as the calf. / Having fasted and thoroughly worshipped the lord of the gods who lies upon the waters,
with flowers, incense, and offerings according to one's means, / a devoted man should present it to a brahmin dressed in fresh garments,
having uttered: 'May Keśava, who lies upon the waters, the source of the universe, be pleased with me.' / Thus he should give it, and the twice-born should also satisfy him.
Having fasted for a day and night, he should give it according to the rule declared by me; / after this he must remain eating uncooked food for a day and night.
Having given the water-cow according to this rule, O foremost of the twice-born, / he attains every delight and obtains eternal desires.
That man likewise attains liberation from all [burdens of] austerities; / he obtains great good fortune and supreme beauty.
Into whosever sight that man comes, / to each and every one he brings supreme delight, O foremost of the twice-born.
He is perpetually satisfied and likewise free from disease; / rid of blemish, he attains the pacification of all afflictions.

3.62.s:
vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnoti sakṛddātā dvijottamaḥ ..
dattvā tāmasakṛdviprā lokamāpnoti vaiṣṇavam .. 14 ..
āhlādahetoḥ paramaṃ pavitraṃ dānaṃ mayedaṃ kathitaṃ dvijeṃdrāḥ ..
dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ duritāpahāri kāmapradaṃ lokahitaṃ praśastam..15..
3.310
haṃsa uvāca ..
suvarṇamuttamaṃ ratnaṃ dhanānāmapi cottamam..
lohānāmuttamañcaiva sarveṣāmapi cottamam..1..
agnerapatyaṃ prathamaṃ pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ param..
dhāraṇātsarvapāpaghnaṃ dātustridaśalokadam..2..
mukuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalairhāraiḥ keyūrairaṅgadaistathā..
dhāryate yatsadā devaiḥ pavitratvāddvijottamāḥ..3..
jāmbūnadaṃ taddevānāmindragopakasannibham ..
pitṝṇāñcandraraśmyābhaṃ daityānāṃ śabalopamam .. 4..
nāgānāṃ tacchukābhaṃ syānnārīṇāṃ pītamucyate ..
dattvā kṛṣṇalamātrantu naraḥ pāpātpramucyate..5..
3.62.d:
वारुणं लोकमाप्नोति सकृद्दाता द्विजोत्तमः ॥
दत्त्वा तामसकृद्विप्रा लोकमाप्नोति वैष्णवम् ॥ 14 ॥
आह्लादहेतोः परमं पवित्रं दानं मयेदं कथितं द्विजेंद्राः ॥
धन्यं यशस्यं दुरितापहारि कामप्रदं लोकहितं प्रशस्तम्॥15॥
3.310
हंस उवाच ॥
सुवर्णमुत्तमं रत्नं धनानामपि चोत्तमम्॥
लोहानामुत्तमञ्चैव सर्वेषामपि चोत्तमम्॥1॥
अग्नेरपत्यं प्रथमं पवित्रं मङ्गलं परम्॥
धारणात्सर्वपापघ्नं दातुस्त्रिदशलोकदम्॥2॥
मुकुटैः कुण्डलैर्हारैः केयूरैरङ्गदैस्तथा॥
धार्यते यत्सदा देवैः पवित्रत्वाद्द्विजोत्तमाः॥3॥
जाम्बूनदं तद्देवानामिन्द्रगोपकसन्निभम् ॥
पितॄणाञ्चन्द्ररश्म्याभं दैत्यानां शबलोपमम् ॥ 4॥
नागानां तच्छुकाभं स्यान्नारीणां पीतमुच्यते ॥
दत्त्वा कृष्णलमात्रन्तु नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते॥5॥
3.62.m:
The giver, O foremost twice-born, attains the world of Varuṇa by giving it once; / having given it repeatedly, O brahmins, he reaches the world of Viṣṇu.
This supremely purifying gift for the sake of delight has been proclaimed by me, O lords of the twice-born: / auspicious, bringing fame, destroying misfortunes, granting desires, beneficial to the world, and highly praised.
3.310
Haṃsa said:
Gold is the highest gem, and it is the highest of riches; / it is the highest of metals, and indeed the highest of all things.
It is the first offspring of Agni, purifying and supremely auspicious; / destroying all sins when worn, it bestows the world of the gods upon the giver.
Because of its purity, O foremost twice-born, it is constantly worn by the gods / as crowns, earrings, necklaces, keyūra armlets, and aṅgada bracelets.
That gold from the Jambu river belonging to the gods resembles an indragopaka insect; / that of the ancestors has the lustre of moonbeams; that of the Daityas is like a variegated hue;
that of the Nāgas is like the lustre of a parrot; that of women is said to be yellow. / Having given merely a kṛṣṇala of it, a man is freed from sin.

3.62.s:

tretāgnivratametattu kīrtitaṃ tasya nityadā .. 7 ..
dinamadhyagate sūrye hutvāgniṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
tasyāgninityadāne ca mahatphalamudāhṛtam .. 8 ..

puṇyaṃ mahatsamāpnoti nityadānena vai dvijāḥ .. 9 ..
