3.64.d:
चैत्रन्तु नियतो मासं चैकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत् ॥
सुवर्णमणिमुक्ताढ्ये कुले महति जायते ॥ 14 ॥
निरस्येदेकभक्तेन वैशाखं यो द्विजोत्तमः ॥
नरो वा यदि वा नारी ज्ञातीनां श्रेष्ठतां व्रजेत् ॥ 15 ॥
ज्येष्ठामूलं तु यो मासमेकभक्तेन वर्तयेत् ॥
ऐश्वर्यमतुलं श्रेष्ठं पुमांस्त्री वाभिजायते ॥ 16 ॥
आषाढमेकभक्तेन स्थित्वा मासमतन्द्रितः ॥
बहुधान्यो बहुधनो बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥ 17 ॥
श्रावणं नियतो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत् ॥
यत्र तत्राभिषेकेन युज्यते ज्ञातिवर्धनः ॥ 18 ॥
प्रोष्ठपादन्तु यो मासं यः कुर्यादेकभोजनम् ॥
धनाढ्यः स्फीतमतुलं चैश्वर्यं प्रतिपद्यते ॥ 19 ॥
तथैवाश्वयुजं मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत् ॥
मेधावी वाहनाढ्यश्च बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥ 3.320.20 ॥
3.64.m:
He who, self-controlled, passes the month of Caitra eating only one meal [a day], / is born in a great family rich in gold, jewels, and pearls.
A best of the twice-born who passes Vaiśākha eating only one meal [a day]— / whether a man or a woman—attains supremacy among his kinsmen.
A man or woman who passes the month of Jyeṣṭhāmūla eating only one meal [a day] / is born with peerless, supreme sovereignty.
Remaining unwearied through Āṣāḍha eating only one meal [a day], / one is born with much grain, much wealth, and many sons.
He who, self-controlled, passes the month of Śrāvaṇa eating only one meal [a day], / increases his kinsmen and is endowed with coronation wherever he may be.
He who takes only one meal [a day] through the month of Proṣṭhapāda, / becomes rich in wealth and acquires thriving, peerless sovereignty.
Likewise, he who passes the month of Āśvayuja eating only one meal [a day] / is born intelligent, rich in vehicles, and with many sons.

3.64.s:
kārtikantu naro māsaṃ yaḥ kuryādekabhojanama ..
śūraśca bahubhāryaśca kīrtimāṃścaiva jāyate .. 21 ..
māgarśīrṣantu vai māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet ..
kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano bahudhānyaśca jāyate .. 22 ..
pauṣamāsantu viprendrā bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣipet..
subhago darśanīyaśca yaśobhāgī ca jāyate .. 23 ..
māghantu niyataṃ māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet ..
kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano dhānyavānabhijāyate .. 24 ..
bhagadaivantu yo māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet ..
śrīsatkule jñātimadhye sa mahattvaṃ prapadyate ..25..
strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti vaśyāścāsya bhavanti tāḥ ..
yathoktaphaladāścaite varṣairdvādaśabhiḥ smṛtāḥ ..26..
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ caikāhāro bhavetsadā ..
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ..27..
3.64.d:
कार्तिकन्तु नरो मासं यः कुर्यादेकभोजनम ॥
शूरश्च बहुभार्यश्च कीर्तिमांश्चैव जायते ॥ 21 ॥
मागर्शीर्षन्तु वै मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत् ॥
कृषिभागी बहुधनो बहुधान्यश्च जायते ॥ 22 ॥
पौषमासन्तु विप्रेन्द्रा भक्तेनैकेन यः क्षिपेत्॥
सुभगो दर्शनीयश्च यशोभागी च जायते ॥ 23 ॥
माघन्तु नियतं मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत् ॥
कृषिभागी बहुधनो धान्यवानभिजायते ॥ 24 ॥
भगदैवन्तु यो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत् ॥
श्रीसत्कुले ज्ञातिमध्ये स महत्त्वं प्रपद्यते ॥25॥
स्त्रीषु वल्लभतां याति वश्याश्चास्य भवन्ति ताः ॥
यथोक्तफलदाश्चैते वर्षैर्द्वादशभिः स्मृताः ॥26॥
यस्तु संवत्सरं पूर्णं चैकाहारो भवेत्सदा ॥
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥27॥
3.64.m:
A man who takes only one meal [a day] through the month of Kārtika / is born heroic, with many wives, and renowned.
He who passes the month of Mārgaśīrṣa eating only one meal [a day] / is born sharing in agriculture, with much wealth, and with much grain.
He who passes the month of Pauṣa with only one meal [a day], O leaders of brahmins, / is born fortunate, handsome to behold, and sharing in renown.
He who, self-controlled, passes the month of Māgha eating only one meal [a day] / is born sharing in agriculture, with much wealth, and possessing grain.
He who passes the month governed by Bhaga eating only one meal [a day] / attains greatness amidst his kinsmen in an auspicious, noble family.
He becomes beloved among women, and they become obedient to him. / And these [observances] are traditionally held to bestow the stated fruit when performed for twelve years.
He who takes only one meal continuously for an entire year, / that man obtains the fruit of an Atirātra sacrifice.

3.64.s:
tathā saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇamekāntaritabhojanaḥ ..
yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇākhyaṃ dhruvamāpnoti vai dvijāḥ ..28..
abdamekaṃ tṛtīyehni bhuṃjānaśca tathā naraḥ ..
vājapeyasya yajñasya kathitaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 29 ..
ekakālaṃ tu bhuñjānastvabdamekaṃ tu pañcame ..
svarge dvādaśapadmāni varṣāṇāṃ sa ca modate..3.320.30..
ṣaṣṭheṣaṣṭhe tathaivābdaṃ tvaśnānaḥ prayato naraḥ ..
aṣṭādaśaiva padmāni varṣāṇāṃ divi modate .. 31 ..
divase saptame cābdaṃ bhuñjānastvekabhojanam ..
ṣaṭtriṃśatsa tu padmāni varṣāṇāṃ divi modate .. 32 ..
aṣṭame divase cābdaṃ bhuñjānaḥ prayataḥ sadā ..
padmāni nāke pañcāśadvarṣāṇāṃ divi modate .. 33 ..
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte daśame daśame'hani ..
kalpamekaṃ sa viprendra devavaddivi modate .. 34 ..
3.64.d:
तथा संवत्सरं पूर्णमेकान्तरितभोजनः ॥
यज्ञं बहुसुवर्णाख्यं ध्रुवमाप्नोति वै द्विजाः ॥28॥
अब्दमेकं तृतीयेह्नि भुंजानश्च तथा नरः ॥
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य कथितं द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 29 ॥
एककालं तु भुञ्जानस्त्वब्दमेकं तु पञ्चमे ॥
स्वर्गे द्वादशपद्मानि वर्षाणां स च मोदते॥3.320.30॥
षष्ठेषष्ठे तथैवाब्दं त्वश्नानः प्रयतो नरः ॥
अष्टादशैव पद्मानि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥ 31 ॥
दिवसे सप्तमे चाब्दं भुञ्जानस्त्वेकभोजनम् ॥
षट्त्रिंशत्स तु पद्मानि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥ 32 ॥
अष्टमे दिवसे चाब्दं भुञ्जानः प्रयतः सदा ॥
पद्मानि नाके पञ्चाशद्वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते ॥ 33 ॥
यस्तु संवत्सरं भुङ्क्ते दशमे दशमेऽहनि ॥
कल्पमेकं स विप्रेन्द्र देववद्दिवि मोदते ॥ 34 ॥
3.64.m:
Likewise, eating on alternate days for an entire year, / O twice-born, he certainly obtains [the fruit of] the sacrifice named Bahusuvarṇa.
And a man eating on the third day for one year, / [the fruit] of the Vājapeya sacrifice is declared [for him], O best of the twice-born.
Eating only once on every fifth [day] for one year, / he rejoices in heaven for twelve padmas of years.
Likewise, eating only on every sixth [day] for a year, a restrained man / rejoices in heaven for eighteen padmas of years.
Eating a single meal on every seventh day for a year, / he rejoices in heaven for thirty-six padmas of years.
Eating on every eighth day for a year, always restrained, / he rejoices in heaven, in paradise, for fifty padmas of years.
He who eats on every tenth day for a year, / O foremost of brahmins, rejoices in heaven like a god for one aeon.

3.64.s:
ekādaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāpnute haviḥ ..
śatakalpadvayaṃ nāke modate devavaddivi .. 35 ..
divase dvādaśe yastu prāpte vai prāśnute haviḥ ..
trīṇi kalpānyasau nāke bhuṅkte devasukhānvitaḥ .. 36 ..
trayodaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāpnute haviḥ ..
tasya kalpāni catvāri gatirnāke prakīrtitā .. 37 ..
caturdaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāpnute haviḥ ..
sapta tasya tu kalpāni gatirnāke prakīrtitā .. 38 ..
saṃvatsaraṃ tu bhuñjāno naraḥ pañcadaśe haviḥ ..
nāke vasati dharmātmā deśe kalpānyasaṃśayam .. 39 ..
abdamekaṃ tathā'śnānaḥ pakṣe dinayutena yaḥ ..
sa tu kalpaśataṃ viprā devavaddivi modate .. 3.320.40 ..
dine saptadaśe prāpte yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
svarge sa modate viprāḥ pañca kalpaśatāni ca .. 41 ..
3.64.d:
एकादशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राप्नुते हविः ॥
शतकल्पद्वयं नाके मोदते देववद्दिवि ॥ 35 ॥
दिवसे द्वादशे यस्तु प्राप्ते वै प्राश्नुते हविः ॥
त्रीणि कल्पान्यसौ नाके भुङ्क्ते देवसुखान्वितः ॥ 36 ॥
त्रयोदशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राप्नुते हविः ॥
तस्य कल्पानि चत्वारि गतिर्नाके प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 37 ॥
चतुर्दशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राप्नुते हविः ॥
सप्त तस्य तु कल्पानि गतिर्नाके प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 38 ॥
संवत्सरं तु भुञ्जानो नरः पञ्चदशे हविः ॥
नाके वसति धर्मात्मा देशे कल्पान्यसंशयम् ॥ 39 ॥
अब्दमेकं तथाऽश्नानः पक्षे दिनयुतेन यः ॥
स तु कल्पशतं विप्रा देववद्दिवि मोदते ॥ 3.320.40 ॥
दिने सप्तदशे प्राप्ते यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
स्वर्गे स मोदते विप्राः पञ्च कल्पशतानि च ॥ 41 ॥
3.64.m:
He who takes sacrificial food when the eleventh day arrives, / rejoices in heaven, in paradise, like a god for two hundred aeons.
He who consumes sacrificial food when the twelfth day arrives, / enjoys three aeons in paradise, endowed with divine happiness.
He who takes sacrificial food when the thirteenth day arrives, / his destiny is proclaimed to be four aeons in paradise.
He who takes sacrificial food when the fourteenth day arrives, / his destiny is proclaimed to be seven aeons in paradise.
A man of righteous mind who eats sacrificial food on the fifteenth [day] for a year, / undoubtedly dwells for [many] aeons in the heavenly realm.
He who eats likewise for one year after a fortnight plus a day, / rejoices in heaven like a god for a hundred aeons, O brahmins.
He who eats a single meal when the seventeenth day arrives, / rejoices in heaven, O brahmins, for five hundred aeons.

3.64.s:
aṣṭādaśe ca divase yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
nāke kalpe sahasraṃ tu naraḥ kartābhimodate .. 42 ..
ekonaviṃśe divase yo bhuṃkte caikabhojanam ..
sa tu kalpasahasrantu sārdhaṃ nāke ca modate ..43..
ekakālaṃ ca bhuñjānaḥ prāpte viṃśatame dine ..
kalpānāṃ tu sahasre dve nākasthaḥ pūjyate suraiḥ ..44..
ekaviṃśe tu divase yaḥ kuryādekabhojanam ..
trīṇi kalpasahasrāṇi tasya nāke gatirbhavet .. 45 ..
dvāviṃśe divase prāpte yo bhuṃkte caikabhojanam ..
catvāri sa ca kalpānāṃ sahasraṃ prāpnuyāddivi .. 46 ..
trayoviṃśe ca divase yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
pañca kalpasahasrāṇi svargasthaḥ sa tu modate .. .. 47 ..
caturviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
sapta kalpasahasrāṇi nākasthaḥ sa tu modate .. 48 ..
3.64.d:
अष्टादशे च दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
नाके कल्पे सहस्रं तु नरः कर्ताभिमोदते ॥ 42 ॥
एकोनविंशे दिवसे यो भुंक्ते चैकभोजनम् ॥
स तु कल्पसहस्रन्तु सार्धं नाके च मोदते ॥43॥
एककालं च भुञ्जानः प्राप्ते विंशतमे दिने ॥
कल्पानां तु सहस्रे द्वे नाकस्थः पूज्यते सुरैः ॥44॥
एकविंशे तु दिवसे यः कुर्यादेकभोजनम् ॥
त्रीणि कल्पसहस्राणि तस्य नाके गतिर्भवेत् ॥ 45 ॥
द्वाविंशे दिवसे प्राप्ते यो भुंक्ते चैकभोजनम् ॥
चत्वारि स च कल्पानां सहस्रं प्राप्नुयाद्दिवि ॥ 46 ॥
त्रयोविंशे च दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
पञ्च कल्पसहस्राणि स्वर्गस्थः स तु मोदते ॥ ॥ 47 ॥
चतुर्विंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
सप्त कल्पसहस्राणि नाकस्थः स तु मोदते ॥ 48 ॥
3.64.m:
And a man who performs it, eating a single meal on the eighteenth day, / rejoices in paradise for a thousand aeons.
He who eats a single meal on the nineteenth day, / rejoices in paradise for a thousand and a half aeons.
And eating at one time when the twentieth day arrives, / dwelling in heaven, he is honoured by the gods for two thousand aeons.
He who makes a single meal on the twenty-first day, / his path leads to heaven for three thousand aeons.
When the twenty-second day has arrived, he who eats a single meal / attains heaven for four thousand aeons.
And on the twenty-third day, he who eats a single meal, / dwelling in heaven, rejoices for five thousand aeons.
On the twenty-fourth day, he who eats a single meal, / dwelling in heaven, rejoices for seven thousand aeons.

3.64.s:
pañcaviṃśattame cāhni yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
daśa kalpasahasrāṇi svargasthaḥ sa tu modate .. 49 ..
ṣaḍviṃśe divase yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam ..
sa tu kalpasahasrāṇi caturviṃśaḥ naro bhavet .. 3.320.50 ..
saptaviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
sa tu kalpasahasrāṇi nākasthopi ca modate .. 51 ..
aṣṭāviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
sa tu kalpasahasrāṇi catvāriṃśatsu modate .. 52 ..
ekonaviṃśe divase yaḥ prāśedekabhojanam ..
sa tu kalpasrahasrāṇāṃ pañcāśannākago bhavet .. 53 ..
yastu triṃśaddine prāpte cāśnīyādekabhojanam ..
sa tu kalpasahasrāṇāṃ nākasthaḥ pūjyate śatam .. 54 ..
māsemāse gate prāyaḥ prāśnīyādekabhojanam ..
pauruṣaṃ sa dinaṃ nāke devavanmodate sadā .. 55 ..
sarve vratāstu kavyāya varṣamekaṃ sukhāvahāḥ ..
varṣe tu phaladāḥ proktā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 56 ..
3.64.d:
पञ्चविंशत्तमे चाह्नि यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
दश कल्पसहस्राणि स्वर्गस्थः स तु मोदते ॥ 49 ॥
षड्विंशे दिवसे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ॥
स तु कल्पसहस्राणि चतुर्विंशः नरो भवेत् ॥ 3.320.50 ॥
सप्तविंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
स तु कल्पसहस्राणि नाकस्थोपि च मोदते ॥ 51 ॥
अष्टाविंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
स तु कल्पसहस्राणि चत्वारिंशत्सु मोदते ॥ 52 ॥
एकोनविंशे दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ॥
स तु कल्पस्रहस्राणां पञ्चाशन्नाकगो भवेत् ॥ 53 ॥
यस्तु त्रिंशद्दिने प्राप्ते चाश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ॥
स तु कल्पसहस्राणां नाकस्थः पूज्यते शतम् ॥ 54 ॥
मासेमासे गते प्रायः प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ॥
पौरुषं स दिनं नाके देववन्मोदते सदा ॥ 55 ॥
सर्वे व्रतास्तु कव्याय वर्षमेकं सुखावहाः ॥
वर्षे तु फलदाः प्रोक्ता नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 56 ॥
3.64.m:
And on the twenty-fifth day, he who eats a single meal, / dwelling in heaven, rejoices for ten thousand aeons.
And he who eats a single meal on the twenty-sixth day, / that man remains [there] for twenty-four thousand aeons.
On the twenty-seventh day, he who eats a single meal, / dwelling in heaven, rejoices for [thirty] thousand aeons.
On the twenty-eighth day, he who eats a single meal / rejoices for forty thousand aeons.
On the twenty-ninth day, he who eats a single meal / goes to heaven for fifty thousand aeons.
And he who eats a single meal when the thirtieth day arrives, / dwelling in heaven, is honoured for a hundred thousand aeons.
As a rule, he who eats a single meal as each month passes / rejoices eternally like a god in heaven for a day of the Cosmic Person.
All vows indeed bring happiness for the ancestors for one year; / they are declared to bear fruit over a year; herein no doubt should be entertained.

3.64.s:
snānaṃ sarveṣu kartavyaṃ kāryo homastathaiva ca ..
na bhoktavyaṃ tathā māsaṃ vratasya phalamaśnute .. 57 ..
āśritya tīrthaṃ yadi vāpi devaṃ vratānyathaitāni mahāphalāni ..
kāryāṇi naitānyadhikāstu māsāstataḥ paraṃ nānaśanaṃ pradiṣṭam .. 58 ..
3.64.d:
स्नानं सर्वेषु कर्तव्यं कार्यो होमस्तथैव च ॥
न भोक्तव्यं तथा मासं व्रतस्य फलमश्नुते ॥ 57 ॥
आश्रित्य तीर्थं यदि वापि देवं व्रतान्यथैतानि महाफलानि ॥
कार्याणि नैतान्यधिकास्तु मासास्ततः परं नानशनं प्रदिष्टम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.64.m:
A bath must be performed during all of them, and an oblation must be made likewise; / one should not eat for a month in this way; he attains the fruit of the vow.
Resorting to a sacred bathing place or to a deity, these vows of great fruit / should be performed; these months should not be exceeded; beyond that, non-eating is not prescribed.
